section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1987
title: 22 2.5.3 Out of 12 Metropolitan Cities, 4 Cities registered an increase in the total number of suicides during 1987 over 1986 and these Cities were Bangalore, Bombay, Madras and Pune. The remaining 8 Cities registered a decline over 1986. The 12 Metropolitan Cities taken together in 1987 registered an increase of 1.8% over 1986. 2.5.4 The detailed statistics are presented in TABLE-V.
